day.text: Dockhands everywhere, and a Compact clerk counting crates with a slate. Not now. Come back after dark, when the docks are empty.

night.text: The dock's empty. The crates are sealed with wax and stamped with the Compact's anchor. Under it, scratched small: a circle split by three lines. Through a knot-hole, a cage of light no bigger than a lantern, and stoppered jars, humming. A chalk tag on the lid: "Culvert. Night of the dark." Someone moves this cargo through the culvert under the docks.

done.text: The crates, sealed and humming. The culvert grate is at the land end of the docks.
